description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

description.zh:
HPC集群描述。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以http://和https://开头。

默认值：空
description.en:
The description of the HPC cluster. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

Default value: empty.
The ID of the HPC cluster.

description.zh:
HPC集群名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头。可以包含数字、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。

默认值：空
description.en:
The name of the HPC cluster. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with http:// or https://. It can contain digits, underscores (_), or hyphens (-).

Default value: empty.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 修改一个HPC集群的描述信息
title.en: Modify the description of an HPC cluster

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs modify-hpc-cluster-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --hpc-cluster-id hpc-b8bq705cvx10000 --description testDescription --name testName --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs ModifyHpcClusterAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --Description testDescription --HpcClusterId 'hpc-b8bq705cvx10000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --Name testName
